iut_type: Alinco BR/EDR + BLE transceiver (HFP + SPP profiles)
customer_question: What IOPT test items are required for our product registration? We have BR/EDR with HFP and SPP profiles.
question_variants: Which IOPT test cases are mandatory for our BR/EDR product?
What are the required IOPT test items for HFP and SPP profiles?
IOPT requirements for BR/EDR with HFP Hands-Free role and SPP?
actual_issue: The customer's product implements BR/EDR with HFP (Hands-Free role) and SPP (Serial Port Profile). The registration requires IOPT (Interoperability Testing) test items in addition to the core and profile PTS tests. The customer (via sub-contractor Wireless Technology/Cresgo Wireless) needed to know the specific IOPT test case IDs required for this registration.
plain_english_explanation: IOPT (Interoperability Testing) test items are SIG-mandatory tests for BR/EDR profiles that verify basic interoperability between Bluetooth devices. For a product with HFP (Hands-Free role) and SPP, the following IOPT items are required: IOPT/SR/COD (Service Record / Class of Device), IOPT/BAS/SR (Basic Access Service Record), IOPT/HFP/HF/SDPR (HFP Hands-Free Service Discovery Profile Request), IOPT/HFP/HF/CGSIT (HFP Hands-Free Connection Gating Service Interoperability Test), IOPT/SPP/DEVA/CGSIT (SPP Device A Connection Gating Service Interoperability Test), IOPT/SPP/DEVB/SDPR (SPP Device B Service Discovery Profile Request). These IOPT items are triggered by the presence of BR/EDR profiles in the registration.
consultant_answer: For this product (BR/EDR with HFP HF role + SPP), the required IOPT test items are: (1) IOPT/SR/COD, (2) IOPT/BAS/SR, (3) IOPT/HFP/HF/SDPR, (4) IOPT/HFP/HF/CGSIT, (5) IOPT/SPP/DEVA/CGSIT, (6) IOPT/SPP/DEVB/SDPR. These are all mandatory as part of the Bluetooth SIG qualification for BR/EDR HFP and SPP profiles.
decision_logic: IOPT items are determined by the profile set (HFP HF + SPP in this case). IOPT/SR/COD and IOPT/BAS/SR are common to most BR/EDR profile registrations. HFP-specific: SDPR and CGSIT for the HF role. SPP-specific: CGSIT for Device A (initiator), SDPR for Device B (responder). The sub-contractor performing PTS testing must be informed of all required IOPT items before test planning begins.
final_recommendation: When scoping BR/EDR profile registrations, explicitly list the required IOPT items in the test plan sent to the testing sub-contractor. IOPT requirements are not always intuitive and are easily missed, leading to incomplete test reports at submission time.
risk_if_done_wrong: Missing IOPT test items means the test report is incomplete and the registration cannot be submitted. Discovering missing IOPT items late requires scheduling additional testing, causing schedule delays.
